description: This file contains C++ source code implementing Python bindings for TorchScript's ScriptList class, including iterator support, list operations, and serialization.

classes.name: ScriptList
classes.description: A class representing a list of scriptable values with Python bindings, supporting list operations, iteration, and serialization.

classes.name: ScriptListIterator
classes.description: An iterator class for ScriptList, supporting Python iteration protocol.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Returns the next element in the ScriptList iterator, throws stop_iteration when done.

methods.name: done
methods.description: Checks if the iterator has reached the end.

methods.name: scriptListToPyList
methods.description: Converts a ScriptList to a Python list, handling nested lists.

methods.name: initScriptListBindings
methods.description: Initializes Python bindings for ScriptList and ScriptListIterator classes.
